steps.question: Which text roles does it need?
steps.why: A lead and a display role open articles.
Caption is too faint for a label people must read.

steps.rule: A recessed fill, a step below content.
steps.pick: neutral.100, a step below content (1.12:1 on surface.default), so table headers and wells read as recessed.
steps.darkPick: neutral.100, a step below content (1.2:1 on surface.default), so table headers and wells read as recessed.

steps.pick: neutral.700: supporting text, 9.75:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.500: supporting text, 10.11:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.

steps.question: How much is on one screen?
steps.why: One idea per screen keeps reading calm.

steps.question: How dense is the layout?
steps.why: Room around the text helps reading.
Tables are rare and read row by row, so digits never need to line up in columns. A mono font would break the reading voice.

steps.rule: Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum.
steps.pick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.33:1, on surface.canvas). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.
steps.darkPick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.76:1, on surface.default). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.

steps.pick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.12:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 16.84:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.

steps.pick: source-serif-4 for data text: Source Serif 4 for reading and headings, Inter for labels and captions: a good magazine's text with a quiet interface.

steps.question: What is the main task?
steps.why: People read from start to end.

steps.question: How many signals carry each meaning?
steps.why: Status is rare; color and a word are enough.
A tint shows the choice clearly on warm paper.

steps.rule: The fill of a selected or current item, or a toggle that is on.
steps.pick: navy.light.100: a tint of the brand, 1.22:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.
steps.darkPick: navy.dark.100: a tint of the brand, 1.2:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.

steps.rule: The edge that marks a selected item, beside its fill, so selection is never color alone.
steps.pick: navy.light.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 11.5:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: navy.dark.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 6.86:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.
